newsitem.title: USA: Butler expected to win Peat Marwick chair - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Butler expected to win Peat Marwick chair - WSJ.

text.p: Stephen Butler is expected to be elected chairman and chief executive of Big Six accounting firm KPMG Peat Marwick LLP, the Wall Street Journal reported Monday.
He would replace Jon Madonna, who chose not to run for re-election after his six-year term expires.
The firm's 1,400 partners are currently mailing in their vote, which is expected to be announced next month, the article said.
Peat Marwick confirmed that Butler was the sole nominee to replace Madonna, the Journal said.
